description: the script corpus's bottle-cap thread alone: a triangle (base 2.4 buried half a millimetre in the wall at radius 13.5, crest 1.2 inward toward the axis) in the axial plane at (13.5, 0, 2), carried 2.5 turns along a right-handed helix of pitch 3 about z under the fixed binormal z. The sweep builds in a fraction of a second; the checker's Full S5 on its NURBS faces against each other (the marched NURBS x NURBS section, `spline_nurbs::isolate` under `Marcher::boundary_seeds`) takes minutes, 464 s at 0.9.0's measure, since the marcher was routed NURBS x NURBS pairs (docs/BACKLOG.md, check-full-of-a-swept-thread-takes-minutes). Desired: the same green verdict in about a second. Volume the angle times the profile's first moment about the axis, 2 pi * turns * 2.04 * (R - 0.2 / 3), as sweep/sweep-thread's.
